title: FlexLine Late, Returned-Payment and Delinquency Schedule
content:
Figures used across FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit for late and returned payments and for the stages of delinquency.

## Fees and grace

| Item | All six tiers (FlexLine Starter, FlexLine Standard, FlexLine Plus, FlexLine Preferred, FlexLine Premier, FlexLine Elite) |
|---|---|
| Late-fee grace period | 10 calendar days — Calendar days after the due date before a late fee may be assessed on a minimum payment still unpaid. |
| Late fee | 25.00 USD — Late fee per missed minimum payment, USD, never more than the minimum payment due. |
| Returned-payment fee | 15.00 USD — Returned-payment fee per returned payment, USD, never more than the minimum payment due. |
| Fee-bearing return codes | R01, R02, R03, R04, R08, R09, R16, R20 — Return codes that carry a returned-payment fee. |

## Delinquency stages

| Tier | Draws frozen at (days past due) | Freeze after a returned payment (calendar days from the return date) | Charged off at (days past due) | Reported to the credit bureaus at (days past due) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FlexLine Starter | 15 | 10 | 180 | 30 |
| FlexLine Standard | 30 | 10 | 180 | 30 |
| FlexLine Plus | 30 | 10 | 180 | 30 |
| FlexLine Preferred | 30 | 10 | 180 | 30 |
| FlexLine Premier | 30 | 10 | 180 | 30 |
| FlexLine Elite | 30 | 10 | 180 | 30 |

Column meanings: Days past due at which draws are frozen. Calendar days draws stay frozen after a returned payment, counted from the return date, even when the amount is repaid sooner. Days past due at which the line is charged off. Days past due at which delinquency is reported to the credit bureaus.

## Reading the delinquency table

A FlexLine Starter line reaches its freeze point at 15 days past due, while every other tier reaches it at 30 days, the same day count at which every tier is reported to the credit bureaus.
